analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($45,430) vs SMA5/20/50($50,182/$59,630/$79,986): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weak positioning.
· Position vs SMA100/200($97,819/$112,280): Weak long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (3.5%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (35.3→34.0): Entered oversold territory, continuing decline but exploring rebound potential.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (99.6329→26.4211): Continued improvement, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $41,057): Approaching lower band, 62.29% band width indicates expanded volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($41,000): Based on 52-week low and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing Resistance ($45,555): Previous closing price and short-term resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low 43,985 > 20-day low 43,985): Potential for Higher Low formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.03x): Normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Attempting a short-term technical rebound, need to confirm if resistance at $45,555 is broken.
